This notebook evaluates agreement between a player's recorded attempts within Combine position groups.

## Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)

ROOT <- normalizePath(getwd())

while (!(dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "analysis_r")) &&
         dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "data")))) {

  parent <- dirname(ROOT)

  if (parent == ROOT) {
    stop("Open the project folder first.")
  }

  ROOT <- parent
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = ROOT)
```

## Load the measurement handoff

```{r load-measurements}
handoff_path <- file.path(
  ROOT,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "02_measurements",
  "measurement_handoff.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(handoff_path)) {
  stop("Complete and save 02_measurement_definitions.Rmd first.")
}

measurements <- readRDS(handoff_path)

working_peaks <- measurements$working_peaks
player_roster <- measurements$player_roster
attempt_keys <- measurements$attempt_keys

measurements$decisions
```

## Attach player metadata

```{r attach-player-metadata}
if (anyDuplicated(
  player_roster[, c("draft_year", "nfl_id")]
) > 0L) {
  stop("Player-year metadata keys are not unique.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(
  working_peaks[, attempt_keys]
) > 0L) {
  stop("Working peaks contain duplicate recording keys.")
}

named_peaks <- working_peaks |>
  left_join(
    player_roster |>
      select(
        draft_year,
        nfl_id,
        display_name,
        combine_position
      ),
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

if (anyNA(named_peaks$display_name) ||
    anyNA(named_peaks$combine_position)) {
  stop("Some recordings are missing player metadata.")
}

if (any(!is.finite(
  named_peaks$peak_acceleration_raw_per_s
)) ||
    any(!is.finite(
      named_peaks$peak_time_from_recording_start_s
    ))) {
  stop("Review missing or nonfinite peak measurements.")
}
```

## Identify players with two recordings

```{r paired-player-coverage}
recording_counts <- named_peaks |>
  count(
    draft_year,
    nfl_id,
    name = "recording_count"
  )

pairing_coverage <- recording_counts |>
  count(
    recording_count,
    name = "player_years"
  )

pairing_coverage
```

## Build repeated-recording pairs

```{r build-recording-pairs}
paired_peaks <- named_peaks |>
  group_by(draft_year, nfl_id) |>
  filter(n() == 2L) |>
  arrange(
    as.numeric(attempt),
    event_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  summarise(
    display_name = first(display_name),
    combine_position = first(combine_position),

    attempt_a = first(attempt),
    attempt_b = last(attempt),

    peak_a = first(peak_acceleration_raw_per_s),
    peak_b = last(peak_acceleration_raw_per_s),

    peak_time_a_s = first(
      peak_time_from_recording_start_s
    ),
    peak_time_b_s = last(
      peak_time_from_recording_start_s
    ),

    both_peaks_interior = !any(
      peak_at_search_boundary
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    peak_difference_b_minus_a = peak_b - peak_a,
    absolute_peak_difference = abs(peak_b - peak_a),
    peak_time_difference_b_minus_a_s =
      peak_time_b_s - peak_time_a_s,
    absolute_peak_time_difference_s = abs(
      peak_time_b_s - peak_time_a_s
    )
  )

paired_peaks |>
  count(
    combine_position,
    name = "paired_players"
  )
```

Pairs are ordered by attempt label, with event ID breaking ties. A and B do not certify chronological order or identify which recording produced the published official time.

Single-recording players remain in the broader dataset but cannot contribute a repeated-recording pair.

## Agreement within position groups

```{r correlation-helper}
safe_correlation <- function(x, y, method) {

  valid <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  x <- x[valid]
  y <- y[valid]

  if (length(x) < 3L ||
      sd(x) == 0 ||
      sd(y) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  cor(x, y, method = method)
}
```

```{r agreement-by-position}
agreement_by_position <- paired_peaks |>
  group_by(combine_position) |>
  summarise(
    paired_players = n(),

    pearson_peak_correlation = safe_correlation(
      peak_a,
      peak_b,
      method = "pearson"
    ),

    spearman_peak_correlation = safe_correlation(
      peak_a,
      peak_b,
      method = "spearman"
    ),

    mean_peak_difference_b_minus_a = mean(
      peak_difference_b_minus_a
    ),

    median_absolute_peak_difference = median(
      absolute_peak_difference
    ),

    median_absolute_peak_time_difference_s = median(
      absolute_peak_time_difference_s
    ),

    pairs_with_boundary_peak = sum(
      !both_peaks_interior
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(agreement_by_position, width = Inf)
```

Agreement reflects execution and measurement variation together. Peak timing remains relative to recording start, not verified physical launch. These comparisons do not establish predictive value for NFL performance.

## Position-based internal consistency check

```{r position-speed-check}
review_intervals <- review_frames |>
  group_by(across(all_of(attempt_keys))) |>
  group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
    
    data <- .x |>
      arrange(recording_time_s)

    time_s <- data$recording_time_s
    dt <- diff(time_s)

    if (any(!is.finite(dt)) || any(dt <= 0)) {
      stop("Invalid time intervals in review recordings.")
    }
    
    step_distance <- sqrt(
      diff(data$x)^2 +
      diff(data$y)^2
    )

    supplied_interval_speed <- (
      head(data$s, -1) +
        tail(data$s, -1)
    ) / 2

    tibble(
      interval_time_s = (
        head(time_s, -1) +
          tail(time_s, -1)
      ) / 2,
      interval_duration_s = dt,
      position_step_raw = step_distance,
      position_speed_raw = step_distance / dt,
      supplied_interval_speed_raw = supplied_interval_speed
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r summarize-position-speed-check}
position_speed_summary <- review_intervals |>
  group_by(across(all_of(attempt_keys))) |>
  summarise(
    intervals = n(),

    speed_correlation = safe_correlation(
      position_speed_raw,
      supplied_interval_speed_raw,
      method = "pearson"
    ),

    median_position_to_supplied_ratio = median(
      position_speed_raw[
        supplied_interval_speed_raw > 2
      ] /
        supplied_interval_speed_raw[
          supplied_interval_speed_raw > 2
        ]
    ),

    position_path_raw = sum(
      position_step_raw
    ),

    integrated_supplied_speed_raw = sum(
      supplied_interval_speed_raw *
        interval_duration_s
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(position_speed_summary, width = Inf)
```

Jacob Cowing’s two recordings show substantially different speed buildup. Within each recording, supplied speed agrees closely with position-derived interval speed. Both recordings are retained; the cause of the between-recording difference remains unresolved.

## Observed speed-building intervals

```{r speed-building-intervals}
measure_speed_interval <- function(
    data,
    lower = 3,
    upper = 7,
    hold_s = 0.3) {

  data <- data |>
    arrange(timestamp)

  time_s <- round(
    as.numeric(
      difftime(
        data$timestamp,
        first(data$timestamp),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    digits = 6
  )

  speed <- data$s

  unavailable <- function(reason) {
    tibble(
      status = reason,
      lower_speed_raw = lower,
      upper_speed_raw = upper,
      lower_crossing_s = NA_real_,
      upper_crossing_s = NA_real_,
      interval_s = NA_real_
    )
  }

  if (lower >= upper || hold_s <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid speed thresholds or hold duration.")
  }

  if (length(speed) < 2L ||
      any(!is.finite(speed)) ||
      any(!is.finite(time_s)) ||
      any(diff(time_s) <= 0)) {
    return(unavailable("Invalid or insufficient observations"))
  }

  upper_candidates <- which(
    head(speed, -1) < upper &
      tail(speed, -1) >= upper
  ) + 1L

  upper_index <- NA_integer_

  for (i in upper_candidates) {

    hold_end <- which(
      time_s >= time_s[i] + hold_s - 1e-8
    )[1]

    if (!is.na(hold_end) &&
        all(speed[i:hold_end] >= upper)) {
      upper_index <- i
      break
    }
  }

  if (is.na(upper_index)) {
    return(unavailable("No sustained bracketed upper crossing"))
  }

  lower_candidates <- which(
    head(speed, -1) <= lower &
      tail(speed, -1) > lower
  ) + 1L

  lower_candidates <- lower_candidates[
    lower_candidates <= upper_index
  ]

  if (length(lower_candidates) == 0L) {
    return(unavailable("No bracketed lower crossing"))
  }

  lower_index <- tail(lower_candidates, 1)

  if (any(speed[lower_index:upper_index] < lower)) {
    return(unavailable("Speed fell below lower threshold"))
  }

  crossing_time <- function(i, threshold) {
    time_s[i - 1L] +
      (threshold - speed[i - 1L]) /
      (speed[i] - speed[i - 1L]) *
      (time_s[i] - time_s[i - 1L])
  }

  lower_time <- crossing_time(lower_index, lower)
  upper_time <- crossing_time(upper_index, upper)

  tibble(
    status = "Measured",
    lower_speed_raw = lower,
    upper_speed_raw = upper,
    lower_crossing_s = lower_time,
    upper_crossing_s = upper_time,
    interval_s = upper_time - lower_time
  )
}
```

```{r measure-speed-intervals}
speed_intervals <- measurements$forties |>
  group_by(across(all_of(attempt_keys))) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ measure_speed_interval(
      .x,
      lower = 3,
      upper = 7,
      hold_s = 0.3
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

interval_status <- speed_intervals |>
  count(
    status,
    name = "recordings"

interval_status
```

## Build paired speed intervals

```{r pair-speed-intervals}
paired_intervals <- named_intervals |>
  group_by(draft_year, nfl_id) |>
  filter(
    n() == 2L,
    all(status == "Measured")
  ) |>
  arrange(
    as.numeric(attempt),
    event_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  summarise(
    display_name = first(display_name),
    combine_position = first(combine_position),

    attempt_a = first(attempt),
    attempt_b = last(attempt),

    interval_a_s = first(interval_s),
    interval_b_s = last(interval_s),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    interval_difference_b_minus_a_s =
      interval_b_s - interval_a_s,

    absolute_interval_difference_s = abs(
      interval_b_s - interval_a_s
    ),

    mean_pair_interval_s = (
      interval_a_s + interval_b_s
    ) / 2
  )

paired_intervals |>
  count(
    combine_position,
    name = "paired_players"
  )
```

## Speed-interval agreement within position

```{r interval-agreement}
interval_agreement <- paired_intervals |>
  group_by(combine_position) |>
  summarise(
    paired_players = n(),
    
    pearson_interval_correlation = safe_correlation(
      interval_a_s,
      interval_b_s,
      method = "pearson"
    ),
    
    spearman_interval_correlation = safe_correlation(
      interval_a_s,
      interval_b_s,
      method = "spearman"
    ),
    
    mean_difference_b_minus_a_s = mean(
      interval_difference_b_minus_a_s
    ),

    median_pair_mean_interval_s = median(
      mean_pair_interval_s
    ),

    median_absolute_difference_s = median(
      absolute_interval_difference_s
    ),

    p90_absolute_difference_s = quantile(
      absolute_interval_difference_s,
      probs = 0.90,
      names = FALSE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(interval_agreement, width = Inf)
```

```{r interval-by-draft-year}
interval_agreement_by_year <- paired_intervals |>
  group_by(combine_position, draft_year) |>
  summarise(

    ),

    ),

    ),

    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(combine_position, draft_year)

print(interval_agreement_by_year, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## Consistency findings

Repeated-recording agreement varies by position, measurement, and draft year. The 3-7 speed interval shows stronger pooled associations than observed peak magnitude in the current summaries, but neither measurement is uniformly consistent across groups.

Within-year results remain comparatively strong for defensive and offensive linemen. Receiver agreement varies, while tight-end estimates are based on smaller samples.

Median intervals differ across years. Selected-player comparisons will thus primarily remain within Combine positions and draft years. Individual recordings will stay visible instead of being replaced by a single player average.

These results describe agreement in recorded measurements. They do not establish physical measurement accuracy, explain differences between years, or demonstrate NFL predictive value.

## Save profile consistency outputs

```{r save-profile-consistency}
CONSISTENCY_DIR <- file.path(
  ROOT,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "03_consistency"
)

dir.create(
  CONSISTENCY_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

consistency_tables <- list(
  peak_agreement_by_position = agreement_by_position,
  interior_peak_agreement = interior_agreement,
  paired_peaks = paired_peaks,
  interval_coverage = interval_coverage,
  interval_agreement = interval_agreement,
  interval_agreement_by_year = interval_agreement_by_year,
  paired_intervals = paired_intervals
)

for (table_name in names(consistency_tables)) {
  readr::write_csv(
    consistency_tables[[table_name]],
    file.path(
      CONSISTENCY_DIR,
      paste0(table_name, ".csv")
    )
  )
}

profile_handoff <- list(
  forties = measurements$forties,
  player_roster = player_roster,
  attempt_keys = attempt_keys,
  named_peaks = named_peaks,
  all_peak_estimates = measurements$all_peak_estimates,
  named_intervals = named_intervals,
  paired_peaks = paired_peaks,
  paired_intervals = paired_intervals,
  consistency_tables = consistency_tables,
  peak_decisions = measurements$decisions,
  interval_definition = list(
    lower_speed_raw = 3,
    upper_speed_raw = 7,
    upper_hold_s = 0.3,
    speed_source = "Supplied speed without additional smoothing",
    crossing_rule = paste(
      "First sustained bracketed upper crossing;",
      "latest preceding lower crossing;",
      "no intervening speed below the lower threshold"
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(
  profile_handoff,
  file.path(
    CONSISTENCY_DIR,
    "profile_handoff.rds"
  )
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(CONSISTENCY_DIR, "session_info.txt")
)

cat("Consistency results saved to:", CONSISTENCY_DIR, "\n")
```
